policy.authority: PTO requirements, catalogs, accepted ADRs, and ASL define the release claim; comparison models and implementations are evidence, not authority.
policy.traceability_unit: Every accepted form, direct operation, system register, trap, profile hook, requirement, and top-level ASL state root receives an exact row. Composite state leaves are expanded recursively.
policy.state_boundary: Architectural state, architectural abstractions, ordering instrumentation, and verification-only state are distinguished explicitly; test instrumentation is never presented as an ISA register.
policy.closure_rule: S6-T1 closes only after every Stage 0 through Stage 5 target is closed or excluded by an accepted PTO decision, every requirement is closed, and an independent traceability review approves one immutable commit.

sub_stages.target: enumerate every release-traceability unit exactly once
attach requirement, model, executable evidence, and bounded status to every unit
close every cumulative Stage 0 through Stage 5 requirement
approve claim hygiene and traceability at one immutable commit
promote the release-traceability target without unsupported completeness claims

blocking_gaps.statement: S5-T2 target numeric conformance is open, so cumulative release traceability cannot close.
acceptance_evidence: closed S5-T2 conformance package and closed dependent requirement statuses

blocking_gaps.statement: Independent claim-hygiene review is intentionally unassigned until cumulative requirement closure.
acceptance_evidence: reviewer identity, immutable commit, review date, and accepted disposition
